title: Negotiating a Lease Renewal
summaryZh: 租客與房東討論續約、租金調幅和老舊冷氣，最後以兩年租期達成共識。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thanks for meeting with me. Your lease ends next month.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你來和我談。你的租約下個月到期。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'd like to stay, but I noticed the proposed rent increase.
sentences.zh: 我想繼續住，但我注意到提議的租金漲幅。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Maintenance costs have risen, so I proposed an eight percent increase.
sentences.zh: 維護成本上升了，所以我提議調漲百分之八。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I understand, but eight percent would be difficult for my budget.
sentences.zh: 我了解，但百分之八會讓我的預算很吃緊。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: What kind of increase did you have in mind?
sentences.zh: 你心裡可以接受的調幅是多少？
sentences.note: have in mind 表示心裡正在考慮某個想法或數字。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I could manage three percent if the bedroom air conditioner were repaired.
sentences.zh: 如果臥室冷氣能修好，我可以接受百分之三。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The technician said the unit still works, although it is old.
sentences.zh: 技師說那台冷氣雖然老舊，但仍可運作。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It cools the room, but it is noisy and my electric bill has increased.
sentences.zh: 它能讓房間變涼，但很吵，而且我的電費也增加了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Replacing it would be a much bigger expense than a repair.
sentences.zh: 更換新機會比維修多出一大筆費用。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: If I sign a two-year lease, would you consider a new unit and a four percent increase?
sentences.zh: 如果我簽兩年租約，你願意考慮換新機，並把漲幅訂在百分之四嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: A two-year agreement would give me more stability, so that could work.
sentences.zh: 兩年合約能給我更多穩定性，所以這個方案可行。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Could we keep the same rent for both years without another adjustment?
sentences.zh: 那兩年內可以維持同樣租金，不再調整嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes, provided that we sign the renewal by the end of this week.
sentences.zh: 可以，前提是我們在本週結束前簽好續約。
sentences.note: provided that 表示以某件事為條件。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Please send me the revised agreement and an installation date.
sentences.zh: 請把修改後的合約和冷氣安裝日期傳給我。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I will. Please review the agreement and confirm that your deposit remains unchanged.
sentences.zh: 我會的。請確認合約內容，也確認你的押金維持不變。

questions.q: Why does the tenant object to the original increase?
options: It would be difficult for the tenant's budget
The apartment is too far from work

questions.q: What problem does the bedroom air conditioner have?
options: It is noisy and uses more electricity
A two-year lease, a new unit, and a four percent increase
A one-year lease with an eight percent increase
No rent increase and no new air conditioner
